What we make

Made to measure, made in-house.

Kitchens & cabinets

Custom kitchens and cabinets, made to measure. Panels are cut and edge-banded in our workshop and fitted with Blum drawer systems and hardware.

Wardrobes

Floor-to-ceiling wardrobes with an open TV niche, and a tall laundry cabinet.

TV walls

Floating TV unit with a lit shelf tower.

Libraries

Wall of lit bookshelves beside a staircase with a glass balustrade.

Built-in furniture

Built-in furniture and storage, designed around your space and installed by us.

Tables

Long wooden table top.

Bars

Bar counter with a wooden top and bar stools.

Commercial work

Desks and low storage cabinets for glass-walled offices.

All projects and photos

CNC cutting

CNC cutting, in our own workshop

Our Busellato Jet Optima RT21A CNC nesting machine cuts, routes and drills panels straight from a drawing — for our own furniture, and as a service for carpenters, designers and contractors.

Nesting

All the parts of a cabinet are laid out on the sheet and cut in one run, accurately and with little waste.

Routing

Curves, cut-outs, grooves and shaped parts — slatted and fluted panels, wall cladding, grooved doors.

Drilling

Holes for hinges, shelf supports and fittings, drilled in the same run so everything lines up.

From your drawing

Send a DXF file or a cutting list. A sketch or a photo with sizes works too — we prepare the drawing.

For carpenters, designers and contractors

Send us your cutting list or drawings and get your parts back cut, drilled and ready to assemble. Edge banding and spray finishing are done in the same workshop if you need them. Pick-up in Haifa, or delivery across Haifa and the north.

Our workshop in Haifa

Everything is made here, in our workshop on Arye Shenkar Street in Haifa — design, cutting, assembly and spray finishing — and then installed by us.

Every photo here is ours, from our workshop. No stock, no AI, no filters.

  • Busellato Jet Optima RT21A CNC nesting machine

    Cuts, routes and drills cabinet panels straight from the drawing.

  • Machine room

    Panel saw, thicknesser, planer, bandsaw and router table for accurate, repeatable milling of solid timber and sheet goods.

  • SCM Minimax edgebander

    Applies edge banding to cabinet panels, here in the workshop.

  • Blum hardware systems

    Blum drawer systems and fittings, fitted to our cabinets.

  • Fuji D6 HVLP spray system

    A six-stage HVLP turbine system for spray finishing.

  • Raptor downdraft spray booth

    An enclosed spray booth with filtered airflow from ceiling to floor.

Hello, I'm Tomas.

TLnagarut is a custom cabinetry and solid wood door workshop in Haifa, led by Tomas, with 25 years in the trade.

We make custom cabinets and kitchens, built-in furniture and solid wood doors, and we also do commercial work. Everything is made in our own workshop — design, cutting, assembly and spray finishing — and we deliver and install it ourselves, across Haifa and the north.
